details.question: List the top 10 open accounts where MAB is more than twice MEB.

       m.mab_bal,

details.question: Average MAB for NRI vs non-NRI customers, by product type.
details.sql:
WITH joined AS (
    SELECT
        p.ucic_value,
        p.source_account_nbr,
        p.product_type,
        p.account_open_date,
        p.account_close_date,
        p.dormancy_status,
        m.mab_bal,
        m.meb_bal
    FROM workspace.default.p2c p
    INNER JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m
        ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO
),
aged AS (
    SELECT
        ucic_value,
        source_account_nbr,
        product_type,
        account_open_date,
        account_close_date,
        dormancy_status,
        mab_bal,
        meb_bal,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), account_open_date) / 365.0 AS account_age_years,
        CASE WHEN account_close_date != '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_closed,
        CASE WHEN dormancy_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dormant
    FROM joined
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT
        ucic_value,
        source_account_nbr,
        product_type,
        account_open_date,
        account_close_date,
        dormancy_status,
        mab_bal,
        meb_bal,
        account_age_years,
        is_closed,
        is_dormant,
        CASE
            WHEN account_age_years < 2 THEN 'Under 2 years'
            WHEN account_age_years < 5 THEN '2 to 5 years'
            WHEN account_age_years < 10 THEN '5 to 10 years'
            ELSE 'Over 10 years'
        END AS age_bucket
    FROM aged
),
age_stats AS (
    SELECT
        age_bucket,
        COUNT(*) AS total_accounts,
        SUM(is_closed) AS closed_accounts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_closed = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_accounts,
        SUM(is_dormant) AS dormant_accounts,
        ROUND(SUM(is_dormant) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS dormancy_rate_pct,
        ROUND(
            SUM(CASE WHEN is_closed = 1 OR is_dormant = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*),
            2
        ) AS closure_or_dormancy_risk_pct,
        ROUND(AVG(mab_bal), 2) AS avg_mab_bal,
        ROUND(SUM(mab_bal), 2) AS total_mab_bal,
        ROUND(AVG(meb_bal), 2) AS avg_meb_bal,
        ROUND(SUM(meb_bal), 2) AS total_meb_bal
    FROM bucketed
    GROUP BY age_bucket
)
SELECT
    age_bucket,
    total_accounts,
    open_accounts,
    closed_accounts,
    dormant_accounts,
    dormancy_rate_pct,
    closure_or_dormancy_risk_pct,
    avg_mab_bal,
    total_mab_bal,
    avg_meb_bal,
    total_meb_bal,
    CASE
        WHEN closure_or_dormancy_risk_pct > 25 THEN 'HIGH RISK'
        ELSE 'NORMAL'
    END AS risk_flag
FROM age_stats
ORDER BY
    CASE age_bucket
        WHEN 'Under 2 years' THEN 1
        WHEN '2 to 5 years' THEN 2
        WHEN '5 to 10 years' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Over 10 years' THEN 4
    END

details.question: Show accounts where MEB is greater than MAB for savings (SA) product, top 10 by the difference.
details.sql:
SELECT
  p.source_account_nbr,
  p.full_name,
  m.meb_bal,
  m.mab_bal,
  (m.meb_bal - m.mab_bal) AS diff
FROM workspace.default.p2c p
JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb m
  ON p.source_account_nbr = m.ACCTNO
WHERE p.product_type = 'SA'
  AND m.meb_bal > m.mab_bal
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10

  p.product_type,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(m.mab_bal) / t.total_mab, 2) AS mab_share_pct
FROM workspace.default.p2c AS p
JOIN workspace.default.mab_meb AS m
